remarks: Enjoy the quiet pace of country living in this solid 3-bedroom Cape Cod set on 1.66 acres in the Town of Pike. Offering 1,510 square feet of living space, this home combines character with practical updates and everyday convenience. The kitchen was remodeled approximately 15 years ago and features an eat-in layout, island and gas cooking. A first-floor bedroom and laundry add flexibility, while the first floor also offers a convenient walk-in shower and pantry space. Outside, enjoy the covered porch and spacious yard with plenty of room for gardens, recreation or simply relaxing in a peaceful rural setting. The full basement provides excellent storage, and a generator hookup is already connected to the breaker panel for added peace of mind. If you're looking for a solid country home with acreage, privacy and a functional layout, this property deserves a closer look.
